performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real, but Google spend is leaking with zero conversions.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $895.54 over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded; top campaign alone burned $606.50 with no confirmed leads.
Meta CPL improved: 28-day CPL is $16.35 on 153 leads, with 7d CPL down 13.77% as leads rose 40.74% on modest +21% spend.
Overdue SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA marked Done July 20 but no completed event confirmed — money path verification remains unvalidated.
3-day spend signal (Aug 22–24): total spend collapsed to $115.73 across 3 days vs $334.21 prior 3 days (Aug 19–21) — recurring weekend/dark-day pattern from series.
GHL shows 130 opportunities created vs 153 leads and 0 won — 23-lead gap and zero closed opps suggests intake mapping or pipeline progression leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Ads to Meta — Google has 0 conversions in 28 days while Meta CPL is $16.35 and falling.
suggestions.monday_update: Reduce Google Ads daily budget by $15/day and add the same to the active Meta campaign, effective immediately. Google spent $895.54 over 28 days with zero conversions; Meta is returning leads at $16.35 CPL with the rate still improving. Success check: Meta CPL stays at or below $18 and weekly lead volume holds above the current 7-day pace — review by 2026-09-01. Sohib to confirm before any budget change executes.

suggestions.text: Verify Google Ads conversion tracking pixel is firing — 0 conversions on $895.54 spend is likely a client-side pixel gap, not zero results.
suggestions.monday_update: Check whether Google Ads conversion tag is firing on the lead confirmation page or GHL thank-you step. Known issue per system notes: Google Ads conversions read zero for some clients due to client-side pixel. If calls are converting but not recording, reconnect the tag or import GHL goal completions as a conversion source. Success check: at least one conversion registers in Google Ads within 7 days of fix — confirm by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Confirm Becklar billing drop and BWS duplicate check — both ⛔ blockers are built but unverified, silently leaking cash if wrong.
suggestions.monday_update: Run one dummy Becklar deactivation and confirm the device drops in the Becklar portal and the next invoice reflects it. Then push one live order through each intake path and confirm exactly one fully-mapped opportunity per order with no duplicates. These are built but not verified per SOW — an unverified money path is an open leak. Success check: both tests pass with documented screenshots by 2026-09-05.
